turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Three goals in the final six minutes. I swear, my heart cannot take this team anymore.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Down 3-1 at the Stadio Olimpico, and they still walked out 4-3 winners. How did they pull that off?

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Pure madness! Marten de Roon scored first for Roma, but Kylian Mbappé pulled it back before the break on his hundredth Champions League appearance. Then early in the second half, Donyell Malen scored twice in six minutes. At 3-1, Roma were running rampant.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: It looked completely out of reach. José Mourinho was back in Rome for their first home Champions League fixture in more than seven years. The crowd had banners and chants honoring his two and a half years there, winning the Conference League and reaching the Europa League final.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: And then his substitutions changed everything. Endrick came on in the fifty-ninth minute and set up Carlos Espí with a header. Then Endrick scored the equaliser himself, and Antonio Rüdiger bundled in the winner against his old club. Three corners, three goals in six minutes.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Espí called it absolute madness. Captain Federico Valverde praised the determination of the replacements to keep fighting. Though Vinícius Júnior has been handed a four-match ban for pulling an opponent's hair against Villarreal, which Endrick called unbelievable.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Right, Hyderabad. That was a rough night.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: A twenty-four run defeat to the West Indies. That levels the five-match series at 2-2.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Shai Hope took the game away. An unbeaten 102 off fifty deliveries to push them to 247 for three.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: India came out swinging, though. Sanju Samson hit fifty-six off twenty-three balls, striking four sixes to reach 102 career sixes in T20 internationals.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Only the sixth Indian batter to hit a hundred T20I sixes, behind Rohit, Surya, Abhishek Sharma, Hardik, and Kohli. But Keemo Paul picked up five wickets. He removed Sanju and Ishan Kishan in the fifth over, and the chase unraveled.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Tilak Varma fought hard with forty-three off twenty-five, but Samson singled out Tilak's dismissal as the turning point. India ended on 223 in nineteen point three overs.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Why bowl bouncers at the tailender when the game was already done?

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Sunil Gavaskar was not pleased on commentary. Shamar Joseph kept firing short balls at Arshdeep Singh when the result was settled. Arshdeep got hit on the arm and retired hurt on five. Gavaskar asked why attack the batter when the stumps are right in front of you.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Completely senseless. Off the track, Christian Horner has a memoir coming out on the twenty-second of October.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: His memoir Drive skips straight to Abu Dhabi 2021, when Max Verstappen won his first title level on points with Lewis Hamilton. Horner said that entire season was beyond fiction.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: He also talked about that very tough period in early 2024, denying the allegations before being cleared, though he left Red Bull in July last year.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Tom Coronel pointed out that Red Bull's recent breakthrough shows a familiar pattern, with Hadjar told to adapt to Verstappen's faster way of driving. And Valentino Rossi says he is ready to race Max in GT3, though he expects big trouble.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Carlos Alcaraz had a miserable time in Shanghai.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: He lost in the third round to Zizou Bergs, 7-5, 7-6, and complained about inconsistent balls and the calendar. Why is he complaining about the calendar now?

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Greg Rusedski told him to take control, skip mandatory events like Federer and Djokovic did, and stop complaining because he has the money. Reports say Carlos is skipping media duties in protest.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Alexander Zverev reached the quarter-finals by beating Alexander Bublik and locked up year-end number one. If Carlos does not win the Paris Masters, he will finish a year without a Masters 1000 title for the first time since 2021. And that Six Kings Slam in Riyadh set for next week has been postponed to late December 2026.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: In basketball, the Golden State Warriors beat the Lakers 101-89 in Las Vegas. What did you make of Yaxel Lendeborg?

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: The rookie stood out with seventeen points, five rebounds, and four assists in under twenty-four minutes. Steve Kerr had no Kristaps Porzingis or Al Horford for floor spacing, and Luka Doncic sat out for Los Angeles, but Lendeborg brought pure hustle.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Good energy from the youngster. Brandon Williams and De'Anthony Melton are also talking up a cousin-like bond in the backcourt.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Did you see what Wayne Rooney said about Cristiano Ronaldo?

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Rooney tore into him for walking out of the Portugal camp ahead of the Denmark match. Ronaldo warmed up for thirty minutes against Norway, stayed unused in a 2-1 win, and then accused Jorge Jesus of breaking his word while comparing himself to Pele and Maradona.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Gael Monfils has officially retired after twenty-two years on tour. When asked about his toughest opponent among the Big Three, he picked Novak Djokovic, admitting he never beat him once.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Andrea Stella called the clash between Norris and Piastri on the final lap of the Singapore sprint unacceptable, even though Norris apologized. Formula 1 also announced a ten-year deal to race in Rwanda starting in the early 2030s, returning to Africa for the first time since 1993.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: You asked last time, "What is on our calendar for the next few days?" Here is where things stand.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: India's next assignment is a tour of New Zealand featuring five T20Is, five ODIs, and two Tests, starting with the first T20 on Thursday, 22 October, at twelve-thirty in the afternoon in Christchurch.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Max Verstappen is fourth in the championship on 221 points, 119 behind Andrea Kimi Antonelli, with round eighteen at the United States Grand Prix coming on Monday, 26 October, at one-thirty in the morning.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Can Verstappen close a gap that big?

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: Almost impossible. As for fixtures, Saturday at seven-thirty in the morning brings Warriors against Portland in preseason. Saturday evening at seven, India take on the West Indies in the decider at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Right in Bengaluru. All on the line.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: On Monday at twelve-thirty in the morning, Real Madrid host Sevilla in La Liga. Thursday, 22 October, is loaded: Real Madrid play RB Leipzig in the Champions League at twelve-thirty in the morning, the Warriors open their regular season at the Lakers at seven-thirty in the morning, and India play the first T20 against New Zealand at Hagley Oval at twelve-thirty in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: Kylo
turns.text: Massive week coming up. Get your rest.

turns.speaker: Dhruv
turns.text: That's Side effects of Sports for today. Same time tomorrow.
